Font Awesome 4.7.0 by Dave Gandy - http://fontawesome.io

Font files (fonts/): SIL Open Font License 1.1 - https://scripts.sil.org/OFL
CSS (css/font-awesome.min.css): MIT License - https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT

Self-hosted by NotificationX instead of loaded from cdnjs (WordPress.org
Guideline 8, issue #184). Only the woff2 and woff font formats are bundled;
the @font-face rule in css/font-awesome.min.css lists only those two.
